title: Bank of Canada raises its policy rate by 25 bps
points: First hike since July 2023, ending seven straight holds.
Prime moves 4.45% → 4.70%, so variable-rate borrowers pay about 0.25 pts more. Fixed rates barely moved on the day: they follow bond yields, not the policy rate.
Reason: persistent inflation from energy costs threatens to spread more broadly. Macklem said further hikes might be needed but the Bank will "proceed carefully".
Outlook: CPI averaging about 3% through 2027, back to 2% by mid-2028; 2026 growth about 1.0%.
